title: Spot Award for a sprint process that raised completion to 85%
summary: I proposed a 'scaling for development' process in the fraud and risk org to help teams fit Scrum to their context and introduced it in my team; our sprint task completion rose to 85% and a senior manager gave me a Spot Award.
what_would_have_happened: Sprints kept finishing only half to 60 percent of committed work.
the_call: Fit the Scrum process to each team's context.
what_i_did: Proposed the guidelines, introduced them in my team's sprints and helped the team adopt them.
what_changed: Task completion rose from roughly 50-60% to 85%, and the org recognized the change with a Spot Award.

quotes.text: Process Oriented and Methodological is Datta's super power. He approaches every problem step by step.
